description:
This image features a Dell laptop computer situated on a dark wooden desk, with its back facing the camera. The laptop's open top panel is angled slightly away from the desk, revealing a prominent Dell logo in black text at its center. The laptop's light gray bottom panel is adorned with multiple ports, including a power button, while the keyboard is not visible in the image.

The background is dark, with indistinct shapes hinting at a wall and possibly a chair or other furniture in the distance
